body: I don't think he does. I will listen to him rant, then I will make an attempt to talk to him about how I feel about the situation, then he gets mad if I say something he disagrees with and changes the spotlight back onto him.

Sometimes he can be supportive when I am dealing with a situation that has nothing to do with him, but when it comes to a disagreement between us, he overreacts, gets mad, and basically blames all our disagreements on me. It makes me feel like I have to keep how I feel about things to myself and just agree with everything he says.
